original_ai_output.title_zh: 几内亚比绍军政府以安全为由阻止前总统恩巴洛回国
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 几内亚比绍军政府表示，出于国家安全、公共秩序及维护社会稳定的考虑，目前不具备让前总统乌马罗·西索科·恩巴洛回国的安全条件，因此阻止其计划中的归国行程。恩巴洛此前流亡摩洛哥，本周早些时候表示打算回国参加定于12月6日举行的总统选举。军方在去年11月总统选举后数日夺取政权，推翻恩巴洛并中止了选举进程。

key_facts.fact: 几内亚比绍军政府阻止前总统恩巴洛回国，称安全条件不具备
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Guinea-Bissau’s military junta has blocked former president Umaro Sissoco Embalo from returning to the country, saying security conditions are not in place for his planned arrival.

key_facts.fact: 军方称该决定基于国家安全、公共秩序及维护社会稳定的需要
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the military high command said the decision was based on national security, public order and the need to preserve social stability.

key_facts.fact: 恩巴洛流亡摩洛哥，表示打算回国参加12月6日的总统选举
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Embalo, who has been living in exile in Morocco, said earlier this week that he intended to return and contest presidential elections scheduled for December 6.

key_facts.fact: 军方在去年11月总统选举后数日夺取政权，推翻恩巴洛并中止选举进程
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The army seized power just days after last November’s presidential vote, overthrowing Embalo and suspending the electoral process.

uncertainties: 该事件目前仅有一个来源（Africanews）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
